question.text:
How many of the following groups if substituted at o- and / or p- positions of chlorobenzene, increase its reactivity towards nucleophilic substitution?
-CN,-CH3-NH(CH3),-COOH,-NO2,-OCH3

solution.text: The presence of electron-withdrawing groups (like <math><mo>-</mo><mtext>CN</mtext><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mtext>COOH</mtext><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><msub><mrow><mtext>NO</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> ) at <math> <mrow>  <mtext>o-</mtext></mrow></math> and <math> <mrow>  <mtext>p-</mtext></mrow></math>positions with respect to halogen atom activates the aryl halide towards nucleophilic substitution reactions.
